sections.title: Kitchen Confidential & Hate-Watching
sections.commentary: Late-night food critique reaches boiling point as members profess deep disdain for online buffet content while simultaneously watching every single second.

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: I had no options.  Hours at a Brewery with @bclinton_666 with now food.  (I have it on high authority that the Oracles got stuck in a Taco Bell Drive Through!!!)

messages.author: Unholy
messages.text: I’ve only been to In-N- Out once (Vegas) and honestly it was mid. I was hoping to be blown away.

messages.author: MNYoda
messages.text: They just put a new one about half a mile from my place!

messages.author: Unholy
messages.text: I was instructed to get the secret Animal Style burger and maybe that was an error. I should’ve stuck with the standard burger.

messages.author: Unholy
messages.text: It wasn’t gross or anything but I didn’t feel great after eating it.

messages.author: Unholy
messages.text: I was also hungover a bit (again, Vegas) but a greasy burger usually cures that. Kinda added to the letdown that I felt worse after eating there.

messages.author: Unholy
messages.text: Haven’t tried Popeyes yet. Heard the chicken burger is the tits.

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text:
I dig in and out.  I’ll have it this weekend in Vegas at their new 3 story center strip megatropolis location.
As far as fast food burgers it’s up there for me.
Fresh baby….Fresh

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: We don’t have any of the good fast food joints here

messages.author: Pink_Elephants
messages.text: Closest In-n-out is in Tennessee unfortunately

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: They just put a Culvers right across the Ohio border here….too far to drive for a hangover cure though

messages.author: Pink_Elephants
messages.text: I have a picture somewhere where I came to bus tables dressed as an In-n-out employee for Halloween

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: I’ve dressed up as an in and out burger employee myself.  But was for when we rented out a bowling 🎳 alley for a Lebowski Party (@autobahn was an awesome Walter Sobchek)
